description:
To avoid an unwanted arranged marriage, Cha Su-jeong, the eldest daughter of a chaebol family, sets out to find a husband herself. Her conditions are simple: Must be from a chaebol background. Must be far removed from management control. And someone who wouldn't care about things like divorce. A man who perfectly fits all those criteria: Ju Seong-chan, a golf star known as the 'Black Panther of the Field'. She thought it was just a contractual relationship for mutual benefit... 

“I’m the kind of guy who needs to see things through to the end once I start. Whether it's on the field or in bed.” 

With the man's unexpected provocation, Su-jeong's perfect plan begins to unravel. A dangerous contract romance between a chaebol's eldest daughter and a problematic golf star─
